moduleTitle: The Lay of the Vercel Land
opening: You remember watching your Tokyo teammate click a link that didn't exist thirty seconds ago. The Preview Deployment appeared instantly. But the sorcery was this: it wasn't just your code at some random address. It was the entire production environment, copied exactly. Every environment variable, every edge configuration, every build optimization matched the main site. Except for one thing.
